P R E F A C E

The law of Penalties for Breaches of Police Regulations
is an Administrative, not a Judicial Law, which is enforced
in Chinese territory by the Public Safety Bureau and not the
Judicial Courts.

The Chinese Courts in the Settlement are given jurisdic-
tion to adjudicate cases arising under this law by virtue of
Article 1 of the note attached to the Court Agreement which,
among other things; provides:

"It is understood that the Courts established
under the present Agreement shall exercise
jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases,
as well as police offences ."

The police offences referred to in the above-quoted
clause from the Court Agreement are those specified in the
Law of Penalties for Breaches of Police Regulations.

R. T. Bryan, Jr.
Municipal Advocate.

Shanghai, China,
December 17, 1934.

前 言

《违警罚法》属行政法而非司法法，在中国领土内由公安局执行，而非由司法机关执行。

租界内的中国法院依据《法院协定》附注第一条之规定，有权审理依本法产生的案件，该条规定其中包括：

“兹理解，依本协定设立之法院，对民事及刑事案件，以及违警罪案，均行使管辖权。”

上述《法院协定》引文中提及的违警罪案，系指《违警罚法》中所列之罪行。

R. T. Bryan, Jr.（小布莱恩）
市公廨律师

LAW OF PENALTIES FOR BREACHES OF POLICE REGULATIONS

CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1. This law shall be applicable to police offences
committed after its enforcement.

Article 2. No act is punishable unless it is so provided
in this law, other mandates or prohibitions (although not in
proper form) recognized as police regulations 1/.

Article 3. (i) A violation of police regulations committed
by a person who has not completed the thirteenth year of his
or her age is not punishable; provided that the parents, elder
brother, or person in loco parentis shall be directed to keep
such person under surveillance.

(ii) If the parents, elder brothers or persons
in loco parentis of individuals who violate police regulations
cannot be found, such offenders may be sent, depending upon
their age, to a reformatory or orphanage 2/ to be reared 3/.

1/ Article 1 of the Criminal Code limits criminal offences to
those made punishable by the law in force at the time the
act was committed, while Article 3 of the Law of Penalties
for Breaches of Police Regulations makes it an administrative
offence to violate (1) the provisions of the law of penalties
for breaches of police regulations, (2) the provisions of
other laws, proclamations or mandates, and (3) the provisions
of other police regulations sanctioned by law or mandates,
although not written in proper form. Article 3 of the Law
of Penalties for Breaches of Police Regulations should be
read in conjunction with Article 33, Section 1, of the same
law which makes it an administrative offence to undertake a
trade or business contrary to proclamations or regulations.

2/ We translate the characters 收養兒童處所 'orphanage'
for lack of a better single word. These characters have a
meaning too broad to be correctly expressed by one word.
They include any institution which takes care of children
whose parents are either dead, whereabouts unknown or un-
able to care for them.

3/ We translate the characters 教養 'to be reared' for lack
of a better single word. They really have a broader meaning,
and might be translated 'for education, instruction and
physical support'.

4/ We translate the characters 管轄地方 'local jurisdiction'. The last two characters 地方 are ordinarily translated by the word 'place'. We use the word 'local' because such is justified by the context. The Supreme Court of the now defunct Peking Government in Explanation Tung No.1635, dated the Tenth Year of the Republic of China held that the words 'local jurisdiction' meant a police district as distinguished from the whole area within which any particular police force operates. According to this ruling, the punishment can only be increased in accordance with Article 8, provided the additional offences were committed within the same branch police district. For instance, an offence against the Police Regulations committed in Yangtsepoo District would not justify the application of Article 8 for an offence committed in Louza District. We understand, however, that in the Shanghai City Government, this rule is not followed and that Article 8 is applied to additional offences committed within the jurisdiction of the Shanghai City Government. If this rule should be applied in the Settlement, any person who commits another offence within the International Settlement may have his punishment increased in accordance with Article 8.

Article 12. Whoever incites or assists an abettor shall be considered an abettor.

Article 13. (i) Punishments for violation of police regulations are either principal or accessory.
(ii) Principal punishments are: (1) Detention of not less than one day or more than fifteen days; (2) a fine of not less than ten cents (10¢) or more than fifteen dollars ($15.00); (3) caution.
(iii) Accessory punishments are: (1) confiscation; (2) suspension of business 7/; and (3) prohibition of business 8/.

Article 14. Detention shall be executed in a Public Safety Bureau Detention House 9/.

Article 15. (i) Fines shall be paid within five days after judgment. If the accused refuses or is unable to pay the fine, it shall be commuted to detention at the rate of one dollar for each day. When the fine is less than one dollar, it shall be commuted to one day of detention.
(ii) If the accused, after having been detained wishes to pay the fine, such fine may be reduced by the number of days already served, in accordance with Article 15, section 1.

Article 16. (i) The following are subject to confiscation: (1) things used in the violation of police regulations; (2) things acquired through the violation of police regulations.
(ii) Things subject to confiscation are limited to those belonging to the accused.

15/ There is no article in this law similar to Article 49 of
the Code of Criminal Procedure which permits the summary
arrest of a flagrante delictor by any person whomsoever
without a warrant. In Chinese territory, the practice seems
to be for the Public Safety Bureau to order, not arrest, the
accused to appear immediately at the nearest station, pro-
vided he does not have really important matters to handle,
and the exact name and address of such accused is known, and
there is no danger of such accused absconding. The order
is mandatory, for if the accused does not comply, he is
arrested and taken to the nearest station. When the accused
arrives at the station, he is given an immediate trial. In
the Settlement, the practice has been for the police in
flagrante delicto cases against the Police Regulations to
take the accused to the nearest station, where he is allowed
bail and ordered to appear before the Shanghai First Special
Area District Court on the next day upon which the Court sits.
If he is unable to put up bail, he is detained until the next
day upon which the Court sits. If he fails to appear when
ordered, his bail is confiscated, and if the Court so desires,
a summons is issued. The procedure adopted in the Settle-
ment, while not specifically allowed by law, seems to be in
order, in view of the many precedents. Great care should
be exercised, however, by the police to insure that no respect-
able persons caught flagrante delicto, whose names and address-
es are known, are summarily arrested for violation of police
regulations. If they are not flagrante delictors, they must
be summonsed and cannot be summarily arrested.

Article 32. Whoever commits any one of the follow-

make necessary repairs to houses &c which are found

property.
(4) Gathering together and making a great noise in a
school, museum, library, or other public place.
(5) Blowing of police whistle (without cause) on a
highway or in any public place (without regard
to the order of prohibition).
(6) Singing in a great voice on a highway or in a public
place (without regard to the order of prohibition).
(7) Drunken and disorderly conduct on a highway or in a
public place.
(8) Quarrelling or fighting on a highway or in a
public place without obeying the order of
prohibition.
(9) Going in and out at places where passage is prohibited.
(10) Hiding in a house which is empty.
(11) Creating a great noise late at night without good

by the authorities.

money obtained by extra charges will be confiscated.

6 months in one and the same police district, the
offender may be temporarily suspended from work
and over 3 offences may be compelled or ordered
to stop work, as circumstances permit.

36. If the proprietors or managers of teahouses, wineshops, or
places of public amusement, permit guests or customers to
remain on their premises after the closing hours fixed by the
police, they shall be liable to a fine of $10. and under.
For a second offence within 6 months in the same locality,
they may be ordered to temporarily suspend business and for
5 offences upwards they may be compelled to close up their
premises, as circumstances.

37. Those customers or visitors who remain on the premises of
teahouses, teashops or places of public amusement, after
the prescribed hour, shall be liable to a fine of $5. and
under, should they disobey police advice to leave these
premises.

POLICE PUNISHMENTS FOR INTERFERENCE WITH THE
LAWFUL DISCHARGE OF PUBLIC FUNCTIONS

ing offences shall be sentenced to not more than five
(5) days' detention or fined not more than five ($5.00)

POLICE PUNISHMENTS FOR MALICIOUS ACCUSATION,
FALSE EVIDENCE AND DESTRUCTION OF EVIDENCE

Article 39. Whoever commits any one of the follow-
ing offences shall be sentenced to not more than ten (10)
days' detention or fined not more than ten ($10.00) dollars:

    (1) Falsely accuses another of violating police
        regulations or gives false evidence;

    (2) For the purpose of shielding an offender against
        police regulations, intentionally destroys evi-
        dence or manufactures false evidence;

    (3) (i) Conceals a violator of police regulations
            or causes such a person to escape.

        (ii) Being an offender who has violated Sections
        1 and 2 of Article 39, and surrenders himself
        before judgment may have his punishment remitted.

Translation of
law in re penalties for breaches of police (regulations)
(dated November 7th, 4th year of Chinese Republic)

1. This law is applicable to police cases which occur after it has been put into effect.

2. According to this and other law or mandates or recognised police regulations, should there be no proper (legal) clauses, no penalty should be inflicted upon any action whatsoever (this is not clear?)

3. Any person under 12 years old shall not be penalised for a breach of police regulations, but his or her parent or guardians shall be informed and directed to put him or her under their own surveillance. In case the parent or guardians cannot be found, he or she shall be given some reformation - instruction according to age and be sent to the reformatory - refuge.

4. Insane persons shall not be penalised for an obstruction to police, except the offence is committed when they are sane (?) Whenever insane persons commit a breach of police regulations, their parents or guardians shall be informed and directed to place them under their own surveillance, without regard whether or not they have been penalised.
In case their parents or guardians cannot be found, they shall be sent to insane hospitals or refuges.

5. Whenever obstruction to police is unavoidably committed owing to self-defence or rescue of others out of immediate danger, no penalty is to be imposed, but in cases of excesses, the penalty may be reduced by 1st or 2nd grade.

6. Whenever anyone is forced by nature or unable to check it by man power, such a breach shall not be penalised.

7. Any obstruction to police without effect is not punishable.

8. Any one committing the 2nd offence in the same locality within 6 months of the 1st breach of police regulations, shall be punishable by the addition of one grade, and for 3 offences upwards, by the addition of two grades.
With reference to police cases referred to in clause 1 of Art, 3 and clause 2 of Art.4, the parents or guardians shall be answerable for further offences within 6 months in the same district.
The above penalties shall however be in the form of a fine or fines.

9. Any one concerned for breaches for two articles of the law simultaneously shall be dealt with separately.

10. Two or more persons jointly commit a breach of police regulations, they will each be summarily dealt with.
Those assisting the principal offenders before or after, are accessories and will be punishable with a reduction of one grade.

11. Those who instigate others to obstruct the police will be dealt with as actual offenders.

12. Those instigating or assisting accessories will be dealt with as accessories.

关于违警罚法之翻译
（中华民国四年十一月七日颁布）

1. 本法适用于施行后发生的违警案件。

2. 根据本法及其他法律、法令或公认的警务规章，若无适当（法律）条款，则任何行为均不应受到处罚（此处原文不清？）

3. 未满十二岁之人违警，不予处罚，但应通知其父母或监护人，并责令由其自行监管。若找不到父母或监护人，应根据其年龄给予一定的感化教育，并送往感化院或收容所。

4. 精神病人阻碍警务，不予处罚，除非该违法行为是在其神志清醒时犯下（？）。每当精神病人违警，应通知其父母或监护人，并责令由其自行监管，不论其是否已受处罚。
若找不到其父母或监护人，应将其送往精神病院或收容所。

5. 凡因自卫或救助他人脱离紧迫危险而不可避免地阻碍警务者，不予处罚；但若行为过当，可减轻一等或二等处罚。

6. 凡因自然力所迫或人力无法控制而违警者，不予处罚。

7. 未造成后果的阻碍警务行为，不予处罚。

8. 凡在第一次违警后六个月内，在同一地点再次违警者，加重一等处罚；三次及以上者，加重二等处罚。
关于第三条第一款及第四条第二款所述的违警案件，父母或监护人应对六个月内同一辖区内的进一步违规行为负责。
上述处罚应以罚款形式执行。

9. 同时违反两条法律条款者，应分别处理。

10. 两人或多人共同违警者，各自予以简易处理。
事前或事后协助主犯者，为从犯，减轻一等处罚。

11. 教唆他人阻碍警务者，按正犯处理。

12. 教唆或协助从犯者，按从犯处理。

13. The penalties against a breach of police regulations
for principal offenders are:-
(1) Detention of from 1 to 15 days.
(2) A fine of from 10 cents to $15.00
(3) Caution
For accessories:-
(1) Confiscation (?)
(2) Suspension of business
(3) Compulsion to stop business.

14. To be detained in custody in the police court (?).

15. The amount of fine decided in Court to be paid within
5 days, failure to do so or inability to pay, will take
imprisonment instead at $1. or less than $1. per day.
Those who wish to pay his fine after having already
been placed in custody, the amount may be deducted by
the days of imprisonment.

16. Articles to be confiscated are as follows:-
(1) The article used in attacking the police.
(2) Articles obtained from obstruction to the police.

17. The period for suspension of business shall be under
10 days.

18. The penalty - compulsion to stop business is applicable
to similar cases involving a breach of police regulations.

19. Should there any damage or loss of property as a result
of breach of police regulations, besides the imposition
of the usual penalties, the offenders may also be ordered
to pay some compensation.

20. Whose who have committed a breach of police regulations
voluntarily present themselves at the police stations
before detection, the penalty will be reduced by 1 or 2
grades or let off simply by a caution, (but any stipulations
outside this law are excepted).

21. When hearing police cases, the sentence passed may be
heavier or lighter by the addition or reduction of 8 or 2
grades according to the merits of each case.

22. Under the penalty provided for in art. 9 the detention
period shall not exceed 30 days and the fine shall not
exceed $30.

23. The "one grade" mentioned in this law refers to a quarter
of the period of imprisonment, or the fixed amount of fine.
Where the period of detention is less than one day or less
than ten cents as a result of reduction of penalty, it
may be waived altogether, except "Confiscation" which is
not to be waived.

24. Where "as under" or "as above" are mentioned in this law,
any calculation (of time or amount) shall include the
principal amount.

25. Whenever any prisoners having served half period of his
sentence, may be released when and if he shows signs of
repentance.

13. 违警正犯的处罚如下：
(1) 拘留一至十五日。
(2) 罚款一角至十五元。
(3) 警告
对从犯：
(1) 没收（？）
(2) 停业
(3) 强制停业。

14. 在警察法庭（？）羁押。

15. 法院判定的罚款金额须在五日内缴纳，若未缴纳或无力缴纳，则以监禁代替，每日折算一元或少于一元。
那些在被羁押后希望缴纳罚款的人，可按监禁天数扣除相应金额。

16. 应予没收的物品如下：
(1) 用于攻击警察的物品。
(2) 从阻碍警务行为中获得的物品。

17. 停业期限应在十日以下。

18. 强制停业的处罚适用于涉及违警的类似案件。

19. 若因违警导致财产损失或损害，除施加常规处罚外，还可责令违法者支付一定赔偿。

20. 凡违警后在被发觉前主动向警察局自首者，减轻一等或二等处罚，或仅予以警告（但本法规定以外的条款除外）。

21. 审理违警案件时，可根据各案情节，加减八等或二等，判处较重或较轻的刑罚。

22. 根据第九条规定的处罚，拘留期不得超过三十日，罚款不得超过三十元。

23. 本法所述“一等”，指刑期的四分之一，或固定罚款金额的四分之一。若因减刑导致拘留期不足一日或罚款不足一角，可完全免除，但“没收”不得免除。

24. 本法中提到“如下”或“如上”时，任何计算（时间或金额）应包括本数。

25. 凡服刑过半的囚犯，若表现出悔意，可予释放。

26. Whenever any person commits a breach of police regulations, the police may bring him to Court without a summons, except in the case of one who has some business to do or whose name and address are known or who will not run away.

27. Any one charged on suspicion in a police case shall appear at Court within 3 days after receipt of a summons, failure to attend promptly will entail punishment according to law.

28. Proceedings against a breach of police regulations shall be instituted within a period of 6 months. Any sentence passed if not carried out within 6 months after the date of judgment, will be cancelled.

29. 24 hours will count one day, and 30 days, one month.

30. The commencing day will not count the hour and the last day shall be a full day.

31. The release of prisoners from the prison shall take place on the afternoon on the day of expiration.

32. Whoever commits one of the following offences shall be punishable by imprisonment under 15 days or a fine under $15.00.
(1) Manufacturer or sale of fireworks without first obtaining permission from the local authorities.
(2) Firing of fireworks or fire-arms (?) in the midst of crowds.
(3) When anyone knows there are ammunition or explosives stuff but refrain from reporting to the police authorities.
(4) Carrying of firearms without permission from the authorities.
(5) Dissemination of rumours.
(6) Reckless burning (?) of anything near a private house or in the country fields.
(7) At the time of a fire or famine, disobedience of the authorities' orders to take protective measures.
(8) Wilfully allowing mad persons, rabid dogs or dangerous animals to run into any highway, private houses or public structures.

33. Whoever who commits one of the following acts shall be punishable by imprisonment under 15 days or a fine under $15.00
(1) Undertaking any work or trade contrary to law regulations.
(2) Opening any theatre or place of public entertainment contrary to law or regulations.
(3) Not reporting to the police any person staying in his lodging house well knowing the man to be a criminal.

34. Whoever who commits any one of the following acts shall be punishable by imprisonment under 10 days or a fine under $10.00
(1) Marriage, birth or death and removal without first reporting to the police authorities in accordance with the provisions of law and regulations.
(2) Building structures (houses) without first reporting to the police authorities in accordance with the law and regulations and not according to approved plans.
(3) Failure to register the names, age, occupation etc., of guests staying in lodging houses.

30. 起始之日不计小时，最后一日应计为完整的一日。

31. 囚犯应于刑期届满当日下午释放。

32. 凡犯下列罪行之一者，处15日以下监禁或15.00元以下罚款。
(1) 未先获得地方当局许可而制造或销售烟花爆竹。
(2) 在人群密集处燃放烟花爆竹或火器（原文存疑）。
(3) 明知有弹药或爆炸物而不向警方报告。
(4) 未经当局许可携带火器。
(5) 散布谣言。

(2) 违反法律法规开设任何剧院或公共娱乐场所。
(3) 明知某人是罪犯而容留其住宿，且不向警方报告。

34. 凡有下列行为之一者，处10日以下监禁或10.00元以下罚款

(2) 建造建筑物（房屋），未按照法律法规先向警方报告，且未按批准图纸施工。

36. If the proprietors or managers of teahouses, wineshops, or places of public amusement, permit guests or customers to remain on their premises after the closing hours fixed by the police, they shall be liable to a fine of $10. and under. 38. Those offending one of the following acts will be liable to arrest and detention of 5 days and under or a fine of $5. and under:-

Translation of
Law in re penalties for breaches of police (regulations)
(dated November 7th, 4th year of Chinese Republic)

1. This law is applicable to police cases which occur after it
has been put into effect.

2. According to this and other law or mandates or recognised
police regulations, should there be no proper (legal)
clauses, no penalty should be inflicted upon any action
whatsoever (this is not clear?)

3. Any person under 12 years old shall not be penalised for
a breach of police regulations, but his or her parent or
guardians shall be informed and directed to put him or
her under their own surveillance. In case the parent or
guardians cannot be found, he or she shall be given some
reformation - instruction according to age and be sent
to the reformatory - refuge.

4. Insane persons shall not be penalised for an obstruction to
police, except the offence is committed when they are sane (?)
Whenever insane persons commit a breach of police regulations,
their parents or guardians shall be informed and directed
to place them under their own surveillance, without regard
whether or not they have been penalised.
In case their parents or guardians cannot be found they
shall be sent to insane hospitals or refuges.

5. Whenever obstruction to police is unavoidably committed
owing to self-defence or rescue of others out of immediate
danger, no penalty is to be imposed, but in cases of excesses,
the penalty may be reduced by 1st or 2nd grade.

6. Whenever anyone is forced by nature or unable to check it
by man power, such a breach shall not be penalised.

7. Any obstruction to police without effect is not punishable.

8. Any one committing the 2nd offence in the same locality
within 6 months of the 1st breach of police regulations,
shall be punishable by the addition of one grade, and for
3 offences upwards, by the addition of two grades.
With reference to police cases referred to in clause 1
of Art, 3 and clause 2 of Art.4, the parents or guardians
shall be answerable for further offences within 6 months
in the same district.
The above penalties shall however be in the form of a fine
or fines.

9. Any one concerned for breaches for two articles of the law
simultaneously shall be dealt with separately.

10. Two or more persons jointly commit a breach of police
regulations, they will each be summarily dealt with.
Those assisting the principal offenders before or after,
are accessories and will be punishable with a reduction
of one grade.

11. Those who instigate others to obstruct the police will be
dealt with as actual offenders.

12. Those instigating or assisting accessories will be dealt
with as accessories.

关于违反警察（规章）处罚之法律
（中华民国四年十一月七日）

1. 本法适用于生效后发生的警察案件。

2. 根据本法及其他法律、法令或公认的警察规章，若无适当（法律）条款，则对任何行为均不予处罚（此处原文不清？）

3. 未满12岁之人违反警察规章者，不予处罚，但应通知其父母或监护人，并责令对其加以监管。若找不到父母或监护人，应根据其年龄给予一定的感化教育，并送往感化院或收容所。

4. 精神病人妨碍警务者，不予处罚，除非该罪行是在其神志清醒时犯下（原文存疑）。每当精神病人违反警察规章时，无论是否已受处罚，均应通知其父母或监护人，并责令对其加以监管。若找不到其父母或监护人，应将其送往精神病院或收容所。

5. 凡因自卫或救助他人脱离紧迫危险而不可避免地妨碍警务者，不予处罚；但若行为过当，刑罚可减轻一至二等。

6. 凡因自然力量所迫或人力无法控制而造成的违规，不予处罚。

7. 未产生后果的妨碍警务行为，不予处罚。

8. 凡在首次违反警察规章后六个月内，在同一地点再犯第二次者，刑罚加重一等；三次及以上者，加重二等。
关于第三条第一款及第四条第二款所述的警察案件，父母或监护人应对六个月内同一地区的再次违规行为负责。
上述处罚应以罚款形式执行。

9. 凡同时触犯法律两条款者，应分别处理。

10. 两人或两人以上共同违反警察规章者，各自按简易程序处理。
事前或事后协助主犯者为从犯，刑罚减轻一等。

11. 教唆他人妨碍警务者，按正犯处理。

12. 教唆或帮助从犯者，按从犯处理。

13. The penalties against a breach of police regulations
for principal offenders are:-
(1) Detention of from 1 to 15 days.
(2) A fine of from 10 cents to $15.00
(3) Caution
For accessories:-
(1) Confiscation (?)
(2) Suspension of business
(3) Compulsion to stop business.

14. To be detained in custody in the police court (?).

15. The amount of fine decided in Court to be paid within
5 days, failure to do so or inability to pay, will take
imprisonment instead at $1. or less than $1. per day.
Those who wish to pay his fine after having already
been placed in custody, the amount may be deducted by
the days of imprisonment.

16. Articles to be confiscated are as follows:-
(1) The article used in attacking the police.
(2) Articles obtained from obstruction to the police.

17. The period for suspension of business shall be under
10 days.

18. The penalty - compulsion to stop business is applicable
to similar cases involving a breach of police regulations.

19. Should there any damage or loss of property as a result
of breach of police regulations, besides the imposition
of the usual penalties, the offenders may also be ordered
to pay some compensation.

20. Whose who have committed a breach of police regulations
voluntarily present themselves at the police stations
before detection, the penalty will be reduced by 1 or 2
grades or let off simply by a caution, (but any stipulations
outside this law are excepted).

21. When hearing police cases, the sentence passed may be
heavier or lighter by the addition or reduction of 1 or 2
grades according to the merits of each case.

22. Under the penalty provided for in art. 9 the detention
period shall not exceed 30 days and the fine shall not
exceed $30.

23. The "one grade" mentioned in this law refers to a quarter
of the period of imprisonment, or the fixed amount of fine.
Where the period of detention is less than one day or less
than ten cents as a result of reduction of penalty, it
may be waived altogether, except "Confiscation" which is
not to be waived.

24. Where "as under" or "as above" are mentioned in this law,
any calculation (of time or amount) shall include the
principal amount.

25. Whenever any prisoners having served half period of his
sentence, may be released when and if he shows signs of
repentence.

13. 违反警察规章的正犯处罚如下：
(1) 拘留一至十五日。
(2) 罚款10分至15.00元。
(3) 警告
对从犯的处罚：
(1) 没收（原文存疑）
(2) 停业
(3) 强制停止营业。

14. 在警察法庭（原文存疑）羁押。

15. 法庭判定的罚款金额须在5日内缴纳，逾期不缴或无力缴纳者，以监禁代替，每日折算1元或不足1元。
已被羁押者若愿缴纳罚款，可按监禁天数扣除相应金额。

16. 应予没收的物品如下：
(1) 用于袭击警察的物品。
(2) 因妨碍警务而获得的物品。

17. 停业期限应在十日以下。

18. “强制停止营业”这一处罚适用于涉及违反警察规章的类似案件。

19. 若因违反警察规章导致财产损失或损害，除施加常规处罚外，还可责令违法者支付一定赔偿。

20. 凡违反警察规章者，在被发觉前主动向警察局自首者，刑罚可减轻一至二等，或仅予以警告（但本法以外的规定除外）。

21. 审理警察案件时，可根据案情轻重，将判决加重或减轻一至二等。

22. 根据第九条规定的处罚，拘留期不得超过30日，罚款不得超过30元。

23. 本法所称“一等”，指刑期的四分之一或固定罚款金额的四分之一。若因减刑导致拘留期不足一日或罚款不足一角，可完全免除，但“没收”不得免除。

24. 本法中提到“如下”或“如上”时，任何（时间或金额的）计算均包含本数。

25. 凡服刑已满半期的囚犯，若表现出悔意，可予释放。

page_data.en:
26. Whenever any person commits a breach of police regulations,
the police may bring him to Court without a summons,
except in the case of one who has some business to do or
whose name and address are known or who will not run away.
27. Any one charged on suspicion in a police case shall appear
at Court within 3 days after receipt of a summons, failure
to attend promptly will entail punishment according to law.
28. Proceedings against a breach of police regulations shall
be instituted within a period of 6 months. Any sentence
passed if not carried out within 6 months after the date
of judgment, will be cancelled.
29. 24 hours will count one day, and 30 days, one month.
30. The commencing day will not count the hour and the last
day shall be a full day.
31. The release of prisoners from the prison shall take place
on the afternoon on the day of expiration.
32. Whoever commits one of the following offences shall be
punishable by imprisonment under 15 days or a fine under
$15.00.
(1) Manufacturer or sale of fireworks without first
obtaining permission from the local authorities.
(2) Firing of fireworks or fire-arms (?) in the midst
of crowds.
(3) When anyone knows there are ammunition or
explosives stuff but refrain from reporting to the police
authorities.
(4) Carrying of firearms without permission from
the authorities.
(5) Dissemination of rumours.
(6) Reckless burning (?) of anything near a private
house or in the country fields.
(7) At the time of a fire or famine, disobedience
of the authorities" orders to take protective measures.
(8) Wilfully allowing mad persons, rabid dogs or
dangerous animals to run into any highway, private houses
or public structures.
33. Whoever who commits one of the following acts shall be
punishable by imprisonment under 15 days or a fine under
$15.00
(1) Undertaking any work or trade contrary to
law regulations.
(2) Opening any theatre or place of public enter-
tainment contrary to law or regulations.
(3) Not reporting to the police any person staying
in his lodging house well knowing the man to
be a criminal.
34. Whoever who commits any one of the following acts shall
be punishable by imprisonment under 10 days or a fine
under $10.00
(1) Marriage, birth or death and removal without
first reporting to the police authorities in
accordance with the provisions of law and
regulations.
(2) Building structures (houses) without first
reporting to the police authorities in
accordance with the law and regulations and
not according to approved plans.
(3) Failure to register the names, age, occupation
etc., of guests staying in lodging houses.

27. 因涉嫌警察案件被指控者，须在收到传票后三日内出庭，若不按时出庭，将依法受罚。
28. 对违反警察规章行为的诉讼须在六个月内提起。若判决后六个月内未执行，判决即行撤销。
29. 24小时计为一日，30日计为一月。
30. 起始日不计小时，最后一日计为完整一日。
31. 囚犯应于刑期届满当日下午释放。
32. 凡犯下列罪行之一者，应处以15日以下监禁或15.00元以下罚款：
(1) 未先获得地方当局许可而制造或销售烟花爆竹。
(2) 在人群中燃放烟花爆竹或枪支（原文存疑）。
(3) 明知有弹药或爆炸物却未向警方报告。
(4) 未经当局许可携带枪支。
(5) 散布谣言。
(6) 在私人住宅附近或田野间鲁莽焚烧（原文存疑）任何物品。
(7) 在火灾或饥荒期间，不服从当局采取保护措施的命令。
(8) 故意放任精神病人、疯狗或危险动物跑入公路、私人住宅或公共建筑。
33. 凡犯下列行为之一者，应处以15日以下监禁或15.00元以下罚款：

(2) 违反法律法规开设任何剧院或公共娱乐场所。
(3) 明知住客是罪犯，却不向警方报告。
34. 凡犯下列行为之一者，应处以10日以下监禁或10.00元以下罚款：
(1) 结婚、出生、死亡或搬迁，未按法律法规规定先向警方报告。
(2) 建造建筑物（房屋），未按法律法规规定先向警方报告，且未按批准图纸施工。
(3) 未登记寄宿旅馆住客的姓名、年龄、职业等信息。
